## Deep Dive into Trojanized Minecraft Mod Campaign (Jenny-mod/Fapcraft)

### Lead Threat Hunter - Investigation Synthesis

### 1. Executive Summary
This investigation details a sophisticated malware campaign distributing trojanized Minecraft mods, specifically under the guises of "Jenny-mod" and "Fapcraft". Threat actors are leveraging Discord's Content Delivery Network (CDN) to deliver malicious `.mcpack` and `.jar` files to unsuspecting users in the gaming community.
